results.content:
My grievance is not with the product (it was ok). BUT, If you place it on your visor it always falls off. Magnet is not strong enough. Keeps falling down! Annoying to say the least.  
My COMPLAINT is with CUSTOMER SERVICE (or the lack thereof).  
I ordered it one time and before you know it I have a subscription which I did not sign up for. When I went to see if I have an account (which I do not). My email is NOT even registered or associated with DRIFT!  
I sent them an email saying I do not want a subscription or the product, in plenty of time for them to not send it.  
Apparently, they DO NOT READ THEIR EMAILS and honor what the customer wants. If you do not want subscription they will NOT CANCEL you…shifty business, unethical and obviously NON RESPONSIVE.

## ⭐ 1/5 [...] If you are thinking of "just trying" Drift, check very carefully what you are agreeing to at checkout, and be ready for a fight to cancel. Extremely disappointed. Would not recommend. [...] ## Poor quality product fragrance lasts a…

Poor quality product fragrance lasts a week at most. They do not make it clear it is a subscription service and refuse to refund when queried. Would definitely not purchase any products from this company and recommend that nobody else does, poor quality & poor service.

If i can leave negative stars I would do it, very frustrating experience. DRIFT makes it incredibly easy to subscribe but unnecessarily difficult to cancel. The cancellation process is confusing and feels intentionally designed to keep customers paying, even the product doesn't last a single week I wouldn’t recommend this company.
